name: Horrifique Chtonien
description: Prophète du Néant annonçant la fin imminente du cycle cosmique actuel démoralisant durablement les forces ennemies.

subject.archetype: Horrifique Chtonien — Éveil Chthonien Epic class obsidienne

loadout.armor_outfit: Ancient ceremonial armor fused to wearer's body through dark ritual, shadowy fabric etched with independently shifting runic patterns casting purple light, living shadow tendrils writhing from shoulder guards with own consciousness, armor plates absorbing light instead of reflecting creating void patches forged from rare materials with faction crest embedded and energy pulsing through the entire surface with every movement
loadout.arsenal: Massive ritual staff taller than wielder inscribed with independently rotating forbidden symbols, shadow-manipulation artifact orbiting hand like dark satellite with void energy tendrils connecting to body, cursed amulets chained to armor pulsating with green phosphor light emitting foul energy wisps The weapon and gauntlets actively channel the character's decrease ability targeting opposite_side, visible energy conduits linking weapon to body with flowing power

attitude.behavior: Combat specialist engaged in the heat of battle with weapon and body fully committed to the fight. Both hands thrust forward in powerful push with powerful significant dimensional pressure field expanding from palms creating visible wall of force pushing against entire opposing side
attitude.emotion: Apocalyptic fury — full weight of faction's power channeling through body uncontrollably

style.rendering_style: cinematic action photography with gritty realism, motion blur on projectiles and debris, sharp focus on character face and primary weapon, high contrast lighting with dramatic deep shadows

palette_names.role: primary_accent — shadow energy emanation and tentacle glow

palette_names.name: Bone White
palette_names.role: secondary_accent — skeletal remains and carved runes

palette_names.name: Eerie Green Phosphor

color_and_light.lighting_setup: amethyst alloy frame with crystalline energy channels pulsing light along border edges, explosive backlight from ability discharge, dramatic rim lighting separating character from environmental chaos, volumetric light rays cutting through smoke and particles

camera.angle: Wide dramatic low angle showing full blast radius, character backlit by their own power source, foreground devastated by ability effects

scenography.setting: Torn dimensional battlefield with ground splitting open in massive fissures as enormous shadow tentacles erupt from below, sky showing impossible geometry and wrongness human mind cannot process, ancient runes blazing on every surface as dimensions collapse, reality thinning and tearing at edges, thick oppressive atmosphere of supernatural dread
scenography.atmosphere_vfx: Massive force visible through environmental disruption — air rippling like heat haze, ground buckling and cracking, everything on opposite side being physically pushed backward and compressed, Opposing terrain visibly compressed and pushed backward, barriers and structures cracking from extreme pressure, objects sliding away creating clear zone of force, Massive shadow tentacles erupting from cracked ground grasping at sky, dimensional rifts tearing open revealing impossible non-Euclidean geometry with wrong colors, floating forbidden runes spinning violently in dark purple energy maelstrom, skeletal remains rattling and rising from earth, void essence fog rolling across ground like creeping tsunami
